_readme: Photo URLs for seeded listings, keyed by "Brand Model" exactly as it
appears in seed.ts. Any car listed here uses these photos; any car not
listed falls back to the body-type placeholder in public/placeholder.
Paste URLs you have actually opened and checked. The host must also be
listed in next.config.ts under images.remotePatterns — images.unsplash.com,
_provenance: This file is now the only source of listing photos. Eight listings used
to carry their own inline imageUrls in seed.ts, which bypassed the
checking done here — and 23 of those 25 photos showed a different car:
a Ferrari and an Audi R8 on the Kia EV6, a McLaren, a Camaro and a
Mustang on the Range Rover, two BMW M4s and a Range Rover on the Land
Cruiser, a Bugatti Chiron and a 911 on the Macan, a Tesla and a Nissan
Juke on the G63. Two of the two dozen were right and were moved here
(the BMW M4 and the Toyota Camry); the rest are gone and those listings
now show their body-type silhouette. Two more were dead 404s on
Unsplash and rendered as broken images.
Every URL below was downloaded and looked at before being pasted here.
Photos that turned out to show a different car were discarded: a Hyundai
Sonata offered for the Elantra, a Toyota Tacoma for the Hilux, a Golf R
and a plain Mk7.5 Golf for the GTI, a Civic Type R for the Civic, a GR
Corolla and an AE86 for the Corolla, a BYD Dolphin for the Atto 3.
Seven listings are empty because no photo of that car survived checking:
Kia Rio (only sedans of other generations), Nissan Sunny, Mitsubishi
Lancer (only Evolution models, which is a different car), Chevrolet
Malibu, BYD Atto 3 (only Dolphin, Seal and Song), plus the Elantra and
Golf GTI cleared below. They keep the body-type silhouette, which is
honest about what it does not know.
Cleared on review. Each showed a different generation than the listing
year, which on a car listing reads as a different car — worse than no
photo, because it looks like the seller is showing something they are
not selling:
Hyundai Elantra — listing is 2019 (AD); all three photos were the
CN7 (2021+), a visibly sharper, different body.
Volkswagen Golf GTI — listing is 2019 (Mk7.5); both photos were the
Mk6 (2009-13), a decade and a full generation
off, with completely different headlights.
Toyota Corolla — dropped one chrome front-corner macro that does not
match the car in the other two photos and reads as
an Avalon or an Asian-market Altis.
Kept: right model, and no more than a facelift from the listing year.
Ford Mustang — one 2018+ facelift GT, two 2015-17 S550 GTs
MG ZS EV — listing is 2023; photos are the 2019-21 pre-facelift
Removed earlier: a 10th-gen Civic hatchback that was correctly
identified as a Civic but sits on a listing whose bodyType is SEDAN,
so it would show a hatchback to anyone filtering for sedans.
